source: Stats. 1975, Ch. 2 (MICRA) — enacted §425.13 as procedural gate; §3294 NOT amended
wound_addressed: Punitive damages routinely included in malpractice pleadings as leverage without evidence; nuisance-value settlement pressure; insurer pricing uncertainty
design: §425.13 procedural gate added; §3294 substantive standard unchanged; two-stage evidentiary structure created (prima facie → clear and convincing)
